title: fix(qa): signup-organization-census waits for the verification mail sent after the sign-up answer
body:
Refs #29991

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个注册人口普查的 dogfood 测试（单组织版与有墙版）在注册接口作答之后，先有界地轮询等待验证邮件写入 `sys_identity_email`，再做后续读取；所有断言原样保留。只改测试，不改产品代码。
- 为什么改：PR #29975 让注册接口「先作答、后发信」，验证邮件的记录在响应之后才落库；单组织版测试在作答后立刻读取，读到 0 条，`main` 上 `Dogfood Regression Gate (2/3)` 因此变红。有墙版测试中间隔着其它异步步骤，目前碰巧能过，属于依赖时序的潜在抖动，同 PR 一并修好。
- 风险与回滚：风险低，仅测试文件；等待上限 15 秒，超时会带着明确信息失败，不会静默放行。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/qa/dogfood/test/signup-organization-census.dogfood.test.ts` 的 `beforeAll` 末尾新增的 `vi.waitFor`；其次 `signup-organization-census-walled.dogfood.test.ts` 的 `selfRegister`。
- 两分钟验证：先 build dogfood 依赖闭包，再跑 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/signup-organization-census.dogfood.test.ts`，预期 3 个用例全绿（`main` 上同一文件 2 红 1 绿）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `signup-organization-census.dogfood.test.ts`: `POST /auth/sign-up/email` now answers before its verification mail is sent (PR #29975, `sendAfterResponseOnSignUp`), so the row in `sys_identity_email` lands after the response. The `beforeAll` now ends with a bounded `vi.waitFor` (15 s, the bound `password-reset-ends-sessions.dogfood.test.ts` already uses for the after-response reset mail) that polls `sys_identity_email` for the registrant's mail row. The census is then taken of the whole sign-up, as it was before the send moved. Every assertion in the three cases is unchanged.
- `signup-organization-census-walled.dogfood.test.ts`: the same read (`:240`, the verification mail for both the registrant and the invitee) sits behind the same after-response send. It passes today only because a sign-in and other journey steps run in between: a timing-dependent pass. `selfRegister` now waits, with the same bound, for the mail row before it goes on, so every later read sees the whole sign-up. Assertions unchanged.
- No product code, no shared helper: the two waits are five lines each and read the same table with different keys.

## Sweep of `packages/qa/dogfood/test`

Other readers of `sys_identity_email` or of a mail transport, checked against "reads right after a `/sign-up/email` answer":

- `password-reset-ends-sessions.dogfood.test.ts` and `identity-mail-read-gate.dogfood.test.ts` (`:310`): read the after-response password-reset mail, already behind `vi.waitFor`. No sign-up mail read.
- `identity-mail-read-gate.dogfood.test.ts` `beforeAll` (`:123`), `upgrade-18x-harness.dogfood.test.ts`, `audit-mail-bodies.dogfood.test.ts`: read fixture rows from an 18.x database, not a fresh sign-up.
- `self-registration-grant-first-membership-walled.dogfood.test.ts`: signs up through the door but never reads the mail log or a transport.
- `email-template-*.test.ts`: register `EmailServicePlugin` but do not sign up.
- `upgrade-harness/cli-prerelease-fixture.ts`: signs up and later reads `sys_email`, but it drives a pinned prerelease CLI to build a fixture; it is not a CI test and runs no HEAD sign-up code.

## Tests

Head `ce36ea885f`, dogfood dependency closure built first (`pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0).

- Reproduce on `main`: the `origin/main` copy of the census file, run as a temporary file: 2 failed, 1 passed, the same two failures as CI. Temporary file removed, `git status` clean.
- After: both census files, run three times in a row: 2 files, 15 tests passed, each run.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood run typecheck`: exit 0; `tsc --listFilesOnly` lists both changed files.

The `Dogfood Regression Gate` jobs do not run on pull requests or in the merge queue (their `if:` excludes both events), so the local runs above are the evidence for this file before merge; `main`'s push battery is the first CI run on it.

## Acceptance notes

- Test-only, in a private package (`@objectstack/dogfood`): nothing published changes, so this PR carries `skip-changeset` and no changeset.
- No ablation: the change adds a wait and pins no new behaviour; the red-on-`main` run above is the before leg.
